How to say “I wish ...” and “if only ...”: wish and if only about the present, the past and things that annoy us. The key rule: after wish, the tense moves one step back.
Хочу, щоб зараз було інакше: wish + Past: I want things to be different now: wish + Past Simple
I wish I had a dog.
Не вмію, а хотілося б: wish + could: I can’t, but I’d like to: wish + could
I wish I could play the guitar.
Жаль про минуле: wish + Past Perfect: Regret about the past: wish + Past Perfect
I wish I had gone to the concert.
Хтось дратує, хочу, щоб змінився: wish +: Someone annoys me, I want them to change: wish + would
I wish my brother would stop shouting.
An even stronger wish: If only ...
Якби ж у мене було більше часу!: If only I had more time!
